DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>: Each group defines one router job. All fields except the two password paths and two device-key paths are required strings. Paths expand ~; relative paths resolve from the working directory. Outputs must be distinct and non-overlapping. Existing outputs may be replaced. Run All validates, decodes, saves, extracts, edits and encodes.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.model_specs_path: Required JSON model specification path. Use an existing filename, such as routers/model_specs/Spark_SmartModem_VRV9517-spec.json or routers/model_specs/Vodafone_UltraHub_DGA0130VDF-spec.json.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.template_config_path: Required. Original encrypted router backup; never modified.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.template_router_password_path: Optional configuration field. Text password-file path required at operation time only when the model specification requires a password. AutomationTools does not prompt; a missing required password produces an error.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.target_router_password_path: Optional configuration field. Target password-file path required at operation time only when the model specification requires a password; no interactive fallback.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.router_details_path: Required. JSON object of settings to apply. Keys must match config_fields labels in the model specification. Unspecified settings are preserved.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.router_details_readme_path: Required. Documentation explaining router details JSON settings and how to add new configuration fields.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.decoded_config_archive_path: Required. Required output: decoded TAR.GZ file. Existing outputs may be replaced; paths must remain distinct and non-overlapping.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.decoded_config_path: Required. Required output: directory for extracted configuration files. Existing outputs may be replaced; paths must remain distinct and non-overlapping.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.edited_config_path: Required. Required output: directory for the edited copy. Existing outputs may be replaced; paths must remain distinct and non-overlapping.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.encoded_config_path: Required. Required output: encrypted CFG file for the target router. Existing outputs may be replaced; paths must remain distinct and non-overlapping.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.template_device_key_path: Optional configuration field. Binary template device-key file path required when using device-key derivation. The file must exist and be non-empty. An export password is not a device key; THENC derivation, authentication and signing remain unavailable.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.target_device_key_path: Optional configuration field. Binary target device-key file path required when using device-key derivation. The file must exist and be non-empty. An export password is not a device key; THENC derivation, authentication and signing remain unavailable.
